description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news app. It manages tab navigation across different news categories, includes an app bar with navigation and action buttons, and implements a drawer for additional navigation options.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides a tabbed interface for navigating different news categories, with an app bar and drawer for additional navigation and actions.

classes.name: _HomeDrawer
classes.description: A widget representing the side navigation drawer with links to notification test, device token, and saved news screens.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the HomeScreen widget, including the app bar, tabs, body content, and drawer.
